title: Third knock
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, isolated log cabin on a snowy mountain during a blizzard, cold blue moonlight against warm firelight, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. The third knock came. Then it used Dad's voice. 🌨️

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Dad's journal warned them never to answer the third knock, and something knocked once.
scenes.image: an old leather journal on the floor beside a barricaded cabin door

scenes.narration: They waited. Ten minutes. Twenty. Nobody moved. The fire popped. Nora's breath fogged in the air, even inside.
scenes.image: woman's breath fogging in a dim cabin, frost on the inside of the windows

scenes.narration: The second knock came just before one. Softer. Patient. Like a neighbor who knows you're home.
scenes.image: frost slowly forming around the frame of a heavy wooden cabin door

scenes.narration: At three, the third knock. And then a voice. Their father's voice. Hoarse and cold and exactly right.
scenes.image: a tall blurred figure standing on a snowy porch, seen through a frosted window at night

scenes.narration: Nora. Caleb. It's me. Let me in. It's so cold out here.
scenes.image: close-up of a weathered wooden door with snow piled against it, faint shadow beneath

scenes.narration: It knew the name he called Nora when she was little. Bird. It whistled the song he whistled chopping wood. It whistled it right through the door.
scenes.image: woman with both hands pressed over her mouth, tears in her eyes, firelight

scenes.narration: Caleb was crying. What if it's him, he said. What if he's been out there this whole time?
scenes.image: man pressing his palm flat against a cabin door, head bowed

scenes.narration: Nora said the only true thing she had. Dad's in the ground, Caleb. We put him there.
scenes.image: a lone snowy grave marker on a hillside under a grey sky, pine trees behind

scenes.narration: The whistling stopped. Nora turned away to throw a log on the fire. Just for one second. That was all it took.
scenes.image: a log landing in a fireplace, sparks rising into the dark cabin

scenes.narration: When she turned back, Caleb's hand was on the bolt. And the bolt was open.
scenes.image: close-up of a man's hand on a slid-open iron door bolt, cold blue light leaking through the gap
